criterionCoverage.energyAndConditions: No quantitative energy/catalyst claim is imported; unknown energy source and emissions keep environmental totals open.
criterionCoverage.experimentSafetyAndEvidence: Paper/oral industrial process analysis fits the represent operator; CO generation/furnace handling excluded. Supplied fictional quantities explicitly not measured observations.
criterionCoverage.independentVisualizationBoundary: All whole case objects state imageDependency none; the process must be constructed without copying the existing image.
criterionCoverage.languageAndConcern: All four whole bilingual task/solution/transfer/rubric structures preserve DE/EN demands. No unresolved scientific blocker found; source/course/global holds and lack of human execution remain explicit separate limits.

decisions.reason: Fresh independent P review of both whole DE/EN salt and iron cases, complete E0 profile, original native page/context and full BW parent. Every required expectation has independent visible performance and chemically meaningful fresh transfer. Corrected iron oxygen count checked independently. No profile-body science revision is needed. E1/G1 is bounded to this current goal and reviewed acquisition design; no actual learner execution or source/course/nationwide/human approval claimed.

criterionCoverage.supportedArchetypeExactExpectations: All e1–e7 are read as a coherent own isolation/purification-and-quality workflow: properties, execution, own preparation, controlled original assay, records, denominator interpretation and new contaminant/hydrolysis conditions.
criterionCoverage.twoIndependentDemonstrationsAndFreshTran: Salt/sand separation and original aspirin purification require different material properties and analytical limits. Sugar changes co-solute selectivity; damp storage versus unequal assay age demands independent time-matched controls and actual new tests.
criterionCoverage.goalAndSourceScope: Full BcP12/13 isolation and self-prepared-product purification/analysis duties are retained. The aspirin synthesis produces the own sample for purification, not a new broad synthesis syllabus. Advanced lab-method prerequisite cf263 is kept. No regular-BY-Chemistry or nationwide coverage inferred.
criterionCoverage.chemicalRepresentations: Independent atom counts and all displayed numbers checked. ASA0.30000579g theoretical,0.2470g crude,0.0520g analytical withdrawal,0.1950g recrystallisation charge,0.1600g isolated purified.95.0/85.5/90% NaCl quantities and53.3/82.1% ASA quantities have explicit distinct bases.
criterionCoverage.energyAndConditions: Bath conditions and controlled hydrolysis timing serve a supervised preparation; no reaction-energy or catalyst-equilibrium misconception. Drying criteria and original storage/solution age are recorded.
criterionCoverage.experimentSafetyAndEvidence: Specific supervision/hood/PPE, original independent handling under oversight, controlled quench, fire-free heating, suction controls, separated wastes. Supplied result data remain fictional. Blank original record requires actual aliquots, masses, times, observations, invalidation, inference and limitations in future.
criterionCoverage.ownProductSpecificPurity: Free-SA reference series uses equal final and aliquot volumes,0.100mg/mL standard,50.0mg original sample, Fe(III) blank/pure ASA/SA controls, duplicates and spike. Incomplete dissolution or failed controls invalidates. Melting pure/mixed/own crude/purified samples complements selective SA response. Unmeasured total purity stays unknown; binary ASA+SA correction is conditional.
criterionCoverage.independentVisualizationBoundary: Both cases have imageDependency none. The diagram is no substitute for own observed operations, original data or inference.
criterionCoverage.languageAndConcern: All e1–e7, task demands, solutions and transfer demands match in German and English. No unresolved scientific blocker at bounded AI design level. Protocol adaptation is not a locally executed or universally authorized laboratory method; actual controls may fail and such outcomes remain valid observations.
